title: Open each part from what just happened
statement: Open each part of a lesson, and each video, with a line that links it to what the learner has just done.
detail: A lesson review found that a second video did not show how its characters related to the first, so a learner coming to it cold would not make the connection, and it wrote the rule out as always situating the learner by linking to what has just happened (`othello-course-renderer-draft/repo/docs/rules/pedagogy-and-lesson-structure.md`, lines 215-218). The course renderer adopted it for every part of a lesson and every video (lines 212-213). It is followed by convention; no check enforces it (line 223).

evidence.quote: **Rule.** Open each part of a lesson, and each video, with a bridging line that connects it to what the child has just done.
Imagine a student coming at this cold: they won't make the connection.
**Rule: always situate the learner by linking to what has just happened.**
